card.name: Spread values after a ± sign
card.fires_on: Digits or the decimal point right after a ± sign (mean ± SD or SE), and the word "range" in parentheses after a mean ± SD value. Seen in pharmacokinetic result text.

modes.label: Digits after ±
modes.description: A digit or decimal point in the spread value following ±.

modes.label: The word range
modes.description: The word range opening a parenthesis after a percent change with ±.

card.plain: It fires on the spread number after a ± sign in study results, or on the word range that follows a mean.
